$comment: A LANGUAGE prior. Data only, no code. Staged here for transfer to eoPriors; nothing in packages/ may hardcode any of it.

provenance.source: eoreader6 bin/priors/lang/en.json — hand-curated English abbreviation list, measured against Pride and Prejudice and Frankenstein (see notes below)
provenance.built_by: hand-authored, staged for eventual transfer to eoPriors

notes: abbreviations: tokens that take a trailing period without ending a sentence.

Without this, 'Mr. Darcy' is split into two sentences and every titled name is severed from its title — measured: 'Mr. Collins' occurred in 0 of Pride and Prejudice's sentences against 145 occurrences in the file.

The engine's derived fallback is a floor, not a substitute: it repaired 13 sentences on Frankenstein and 0 on Pride and Prejudice, where 'Mr. Darcy' went 0 -> 0 derived but 0 -> 249 with this file. That is why this exists rather than relying on derivation.
Roman numerals are included because chapter numerals ('CHAPTER XVIII.') otherwise split a heading from the text beneath it.
This list is English. A Basque or Russian prior is a different file, not an extension of this one.
